strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout via `cartTotal(items, { coupon })` in src/cart.js: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items in total, the SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, goods floored at $0, other codes refused), and $4.99 shipping that is free from $50 of discounted goods (an empty cart costs $0). Unit tests in Vitest need to show each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code turned up two likely defects. The bulk check uses `>` where the ticket says 10 or more. The coupon lookup uses `in`, so prototype keys such as `toString` are accepted instead of refused.
inScope: cartTotal pricing: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, coupon refusal, shipping threshold, empty cart
outOfScope: UI/checkout pages (none exist in the repo)
assumptions: Item counts add up each line's quantity, as itemCount does.
Coupon codes are case-sensitive: only the exact string 'SAVE5' is valid, since the ticket says any other code is refused.
A refused coupon is signalled by cartTotal throwing an Error; tests check it throws and that the message names the code submitted.
openQuestions: Should coupon codes be case-insensitive (e.g. 'save5')? Tests assume they are not.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold: the code uses `itemCount > 10`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount
risks.mitigation: TC2 checks exactly 10 items split across lines; kept as an expected failure with a recorded defect if it fails

risks.description: The coupon lookup uses the `in` operator, so prototype keys ('toString', 'constructor') pass validation and produce a NaN total
The coupon could be applied before the bulk discount, or shipping judged on the pre-discount subtotal
risks.mitigation: TC4 and TC9 use amounts where the wrong order or threshold gives a different total

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never go below $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts cost $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1 says 10 or more items get 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:10,quantity:4},{price:10,quantity:6}]) returns 100 instead of 90; the test is marked it.fails and passes.

defects.title: Coupon 'toString' accepted instead of refused
defects.description: AC2 says any code other than SAVE5 is refused. cartTotal validates with `coupon in COUPONS`, which also accepts inherited keys such as 'toString', so no error is thrown.
defects.evidence: cartTotal(items, {coupon:'toString'}) does not throw; the test is marked it.fails and passes.
